fields.description: Reportage Village Dubai is a Dubailand townhouse community with two-, three- and four-bedroom homes.

sources.label: Reportage · Village Dubai original brochure and unit plans

overview: Original mix: 1,321 two-bedroom, 156 three-bedroom and 290 four-bedroom townhouses; 1,767 homes altogether.
research.locationNote: Dubailand, Dubai, near Arabian Ranches. This is separate from Reportage Village Abu Dhabi.
research.priceNote: Bayut records an AED 1.55 million launch guide. No current developer unit quotation was verified.
research.paymentNote: Bayut shows 20/80; PropJunction attributes 20% booking and 80% completion to its two-bedroom reference. Other unit-specific alternatives exist; no original dated calendar was verified.
research.handoverNote: Bayut forecasts Q4 2027 and displays 25% progress. Reportage displays 35%; neither snapshot is dated. Confirm the current contractual date.

facts.label: Area basis
facts.value: Printed whole-home totals include outdoor space, not internal built-up area alone.

facts.label: Levels
facts.value: Two and three bedrooms: ground plus one. Four bedrooms: ground plus two.

unresolved: The 2BR components do not match printed totals. Confirm the contracted plan and outdoor-area basis.
Private pools, optional lifts, current charges and availability require unit-specific confirmation.
